issues.reason: A definite plural takes a group witness and hands a non-event predication to its members through the (PartOf $x <group>) rule — Categorical statements bars the flat group-symbol form outright ('a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol') — so the rule is the nearest licensed shape here, every atom it emits is true of the sentence and well-typed, and the absent group-level position atom is the coverage gap the reviewer themselves filed rather than a rule the parse breaks.

gaps_confirmed: No stated rule for an entity-attached position atom (a non-containment surface-preposition head off a bare postural clause) whose bearer is a definite plural / group: the group-versus-distributed split is legislated for events (group event plus per-member rule) and for copular member-properties (rule only), and nothing covers a position atom.
new_gaps: 'Along' is an arrangement preposition, collective by its own meaning — a line of lanterns runs along a shore, whereas a single lantern does not naturally 'stand along' one — but the collective-versus-distributive test is stated only for predicates (reciprocal / aggregate verbs, bare 'together' / 'jointly'), never for a position preposition, so nothing tells the parser which bearer the surface head takes.
notes: The rest is doctrinal: no event minted for the postural 'stand', the non-containment preposition kept as the entity-attached surface head, the proper-noun premodifier linked by Possession plus its one Name fact, and 'curving' held in participle-as-adjective surface form.
